notes.title: 1.1.1 Update & Debug
1.1.0 Version Update
notes.content:
Dear players, long time no see! We've just rolled out a content-rich functional update:

 - Added pause function within levels. Press X in-game to activate it. Players can observe the level directly while paused.
 - Added a simple hint system for mainline levels, which will suggest actions for each respawn cycle. Press H in-game to activate it. When this hint is activated, the game will also pause.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761724/76202363f966732962d0ca5bd228988a02c237a6.png[/img]
 - Disabled the direct opening of the guidebook within levels. Now, you can still open the guidebook from the pause menu.
 - You can now adjust the intensity of the screen CRT effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761724/387d38a53b29130d68108fd0b4889298ca75761c.png[/img]
 - Adjusted the difficulty of some levels.
 - Fixed some known issues.
By the way, we're gearing up for a larger-scale update, aiming to further optimize the gaming experience for all players. Stay tuned!

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Functional Update
notes.content:
Spring Sale 2024 is blooming. We made a minor update as follows:
- Added a separate settings interface, and separated the settings of Music and Sound Effect
- Fixed a bug of UI selection box
- Optimized some known issues
Happy Spring Sale!!

notes.title: 1.0.3 Functional Update
notes.content:
Thank you for the feedback from all the players. We have made a minor update as follows:
 - Added resolution settings, players can now choose from multiple windowed resolution sizes
 - Reduced the impact of camera effects on UI.
 - Optimized the experience of some levels.
Happy end of winter!

notes.title: 1.0.2 - UI and Functional Update
notes.content:
We are getting more players! Thank you for all your support and feedback!
We continue to modify our game based on recent feedback.
Today's update:
- Color of UI buttons is unified as: blue for default, pink for selection.
- Seleting box in level selection menu is updated. Now you can continue paging when using keyboard or gamepads. 
- Adding key hint of paging buttons (Q/E, LB/RB) in level selection menu.
- Adding operating hint of hide puase menu in level 1-6.
- Adjusting difficulty of some medium-term levels.
Hope you enjoy our game!

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Functional Update（2023.12.10）
Functional Update
notes.content:
Thanks for adding [i]Exp10sion[/i] to your wishlist.
We deeply appreciate the interests and supports from every player.


Since the game demo and store page got published, we've received lots of feedbacks and suggestions about our game demo, from both online players and face-to-face players during offline exhibitions (including G-Fusion Chengdu and USCS Indie Game Playtesting Night). Based on these feedbacks, we updated our game this week:

 - We added [b]gamepad/controller supports[/b] into our game. You could use gamepad to experience the whole game.
 - We updated [b]full keyboard inputs[/b]. Now you can use keyboard to control game menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761724/259d1857a268ce0bb49c18edb94b2599c50f423a.jpg[/img]

 - We planted more [b]detailed tutorials[/b], including game machenism introduction and keybind hints within levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761724/6015fe97938561a514c2ecb5bcdd55ad106f7d0d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761724/6df897aaa1aec2ffdf07adbc4dea9edc1553d4a4.jpg[/img]

- At last, we updated several art assets, like background pictures and UI textures.


That's all for the updates of Exp10sion. All the updates are on both the game demo and the upcoming release version.
Thanks again for your support. Hope you enjoy the game.

Any feedbacks and comments are welcomed. Also welcome to [i]Exp10sion[/i]'s Discord server: https://discord.gg/dnphTuPpjk
